theory.intro: To compare two datasets, work out the **same** summary statistic for each, then compare the two values. The mean and median say which dataset is higher **on average**; the range says which is more **consistent**.
facts: Compare like with like: calculate the **same** statistic for both datasets before comparing them.
The dataset with the **higher mean** or **higher median** is higher on average.
The dataset with the **smaller range** is **more consistent**, because its values are less spread out.
For a time, a **lower** mean or median is the better result — a smaller mean time means faster.
The mean and the median can disagree, so a question must say which statistic to use.
The **mode** is the most frequent value.
If every value in a dataset occurs once, that dataset has **no mode**.
Name the statistic you used when you state the verdict, and read the result in context.
A mean that does not terminate is rounded as the question asks, usually to $1$ decimal place.
steps: Calculate the statistic for each dataset
Compare the two values and state the verdict in context

foundation.question_text:
Two brands of battery are tested.
The lives, in hours, of five batteries of each brand are:
Brand A: $18$, $21$, $19$, $22$, $20$
Brand B: $24$, $17$, $19$, $23$, $22$
Using the mean, which brand lasts longer?
foundation.solution_text:
$\overline{x}_{A} = \frac{100}{5}$
$= 20\text{ h}$
$\overline{x}_{B} = \frac{105}{5}$
$= 21\text{ h}$
Brand B has the higher mean, so Brand B lasts longer on average.

foundation.question_text:
Mia and Tom each run $100$ m four times.
Their times, in seconds, are:
Mia: $13.2$, $13.6$, $13.0$, $13.4$
Tom: $13.5$, $13.1$, $13.8$, $13.4$
Using the mean, who is the faster runner?
foundation.solution_text:
$\overline{x}_{\text{Mia}} = \frac{53.2}{4}$
$= 13.3\text{ s}$
$\overline{x}_{\text{Tom}} = \frac{53.8}{4}$
$= 13.45\text{ s}$
Mia has the lower mean time, and a shorter time is faster, so Mia is the faster runner.

foundation.question_text:
Two courier companies record the times, in minutes, taken to deliver five parcels:
Company P: $28$, $35$, $31$, $30$, $36$
Company Q: $24$, $39$, $30$, $33$, $27$
Using the range, which company is more consistent?
foundation.solution_text:
$\text{Range}_{P} = 36 - 28$
$= 8\text{ min}$
$\text{Range}_{Q} = 39 - 24$
$= 15\text{ min}$
Company P has the smaller range, so Company P is more consistent.

foundation.question_text:
Two machines are tested on five days.
The numbers of items produced are:
Machine $1$: $62$, $58$, $65$, $60$, $71$
Machine $2$: $66$, $59$, $64$, $68$, $63$
Using the median, which machine produces more?
foundation.solution_text:
$58, 60, 62, 65, 71$
$\text{Median}_{1} = 62$
$59, 63, 64, 66, 68$
$\text{Median}_{2} = 64$
Machine $2$ has the higher median, so Machine $2$ produces more.

foundation.question_text:
Two brands of battery are tested.
The lives, in hours, of five batteries of each brand are:
Brand C: $40$, $42$, $42$, $45$, $47$
Brand D: $41$, $43$, $44$, $46$, $48$
Find and compare the modes of the two brands.
foundation.solution_text:
$40, 42, 42, 45, 47$
$\text{Mode}_{C} = 42\text{ h}$
$41, 43, 44, 46, 48$
Every value of Brand D occurs once, so Brand D has no mode.

foundation.question_text:
The table shows the mean and the range of the lives, in hours, of light globes from two brands.
$\begin{array}{lcc}\textbf{Brand}&\textbf{Mean (h)}&\textbf{Range (h)}\\ \hline \text{A}&52&14\\ \text{B}&48&6\end{array}$
Which brand lasts longer on average, and which brand is more consistent?
foundation.solution_text:
$52 > 48$
Brand A has the higher mean, so Brand A lasts longer on average.
$6 < 14$
Brand B has the smaller range, so Brand B is more consistent.

$\text{Range}_{A} = 40 - 25$
$= 15\text{ h}$
$\text{Range}_{B} = 40 - 15$
$= 25\text{ h}$
Brand A has the smaller range, so Brand A is more consistent.

foundation.question_text:
Two delivery drivers record the times, in minutes, for six deliveries:
Driver A: $22$, $27$, $25$, $30$, $26$, $24$
Driver B: $29$, $21$, $26$, $23$, $28$, $25$
Find each driver's mean time, correct to $1$ decimal place.
Using the mean, who is faster?
foundation.solution_text:
$\overline{x}_{A} = \frac{154}{6}$
$\approx 25.7\text{ min}$
$\overline{x}_{B} = \frac{152}{6}$
$\approx 25.3\text{ min}$
Driver B has the lower mean time, so Driver B is faster.

development.question_text:

Brand A: $34$, $30$, $38$, $32$, $36$
Brand B: $41$, $28$, $37$, $31$, $38$
Compare the two brands using the mean and the range.
development.solution_text:

$\overline{x}_{A} = \frac{170}{5}$
$= 34\text{ h}$
$\text{Range}_{A} = 38 - 30$
$= 8\text{ h}$
$\overline{x}_{B} = \frac{175}{5}$
$= 35\text{ h}$
$\text{Range}_{B} = 41 - 28$

2. **Compare the two values and state the verdict in context**
Brand B has the higher mean, so Brand B lasts longer on average.
Brand A has the smaller range, so Brand A is more consistent.

development.question_text:
Two machines are tested on five days.
The numbers of items produced are:
Machine A: $52$, $55$, $55$, $58$, $60$
Machine B: $53$, $56$, $59$, $59$, $63$
Find the mean, median, mode and range of each machine, then compare the two machines.
development.solution_text:
1. **Calculate the statistic for each dataset**
$52, 55, 55, 58, 60$
$\overline{x}_{A} = \frac{280}{5}$
$= 56$
$\text{Median}_{A} = 55$
$\text{Mode}_{A} = 55$
$\text{Range}_{A} = 60 - 52$
$= 8$
$53, 56, 59, 59, 63$
$\overline{x}_{B} = \frac{290}{5}$
$= 58$
$\text{Median}_{B} = 59$
$\text{Mode}_{B} = 59$
$\text{Range}_{B} = 63 - 53$
$= 10$
2. **Compare the two values and state the verdict in context**
Machine B has the higher mean, median and mode, so Machine B produces more items on average.
Machine A has the smaller range, so Machine A is more consistent.

$\overline{x}_{A} = \frac{300}{5}$
$= 60$
$\overline{x}_{B} = \frac{275}{5}$
$= 55$
Machine A has the higher mean, so Machine A makes more items.

development.question_text:
Two athletics teams each have six runners.
Their $100$ m times, in seconds, are:
Team A: $12.8$, $13.4$, $12.6$, $13.0$, $13.6$, $12.9$
Team B: $13.2$, $12.7$, $13.5$, $13.1$, $12.9$, $13.3$
Using the median, which team is faster?

The table shows the mean and the range of the times, in minutes, taken by three delivery drivers.
$\begin{array}{lcc}\textbf{Driver}&\textbf{Mean (min)}&\textbf{Range (min)}\\ \hline \text{A}&24&6\\ \text{B}&28&10\\ \text{C}&35&4\end{array}$
Riya says Driver C did best because Driver C has the greatest mean.
Explain why Riya is not correct, then list the drivers from most consistent to least consistent.
development.solution_text:
For a delivery time, a smaller mean is the better result.
Driver C has the greatest mean, $35$ min, so Driver C is the slowest on average, while Driver A has the smallest mean, $24$ min, and is the fastest on average.
The smaller the range, the more consistent the driver.
$4 < 6 < 10$
From most to least consistent: C, A, B.

development.question_text:
Two machines are tested on five days.
The numbers of items produced are:
Machine P: $45$, $48$, $50$, $52$, $55$
Machine Q: $38$, $44$, $50$, $56$, $62$
Show that the two machines have the same mean, then use the range to say which machine is more consistent.
development.solution_text:
$\overline{x}_{P} = \frac{250}{5}$
$= 50$
$\overline{x}_{Q} = \frac{250}{5}$
$= 50$
The means are equal, so the mean cannot separate the two machines.
$\text{Range}_{P} = 55 - 45$
$= 10$
$\text{Range}_{Q} = 62 - 38$
$= 24$
Machine P has the smaller range, so Machine P is more consistent.

mastery.question_text:
Five light globes of Brand A were tested.
Their lives, in hours, were $44$, $50$, $47$, $53$ and $46$.
Five globes of Brand B were also tested: Brand B's mean life was $49$ hours and its range was $12$ hours.
Which brand lasts longer on average, and which brand is more consistent?
mastery.solution_text:
1. **Calculate the statistic for each dataset**
$\overline{x}_{A} = \frac{240}{5}$
$= 48\text{ h}$
$\text{Range}_{A} = 53 - 44$
$= 9\text{ h}$
Brand B's mean is $49$ h and its range is $12$ h.
2. **Compare the two values and state the verdict in context**
Brand B has the higher mean, $49$ h compared with $48$ h, so Brand B lasts longer on average.
Brand A has the smaller range, $9$ h compared with $12$ h, so Brand A is more consistent.

mastery.question_text:
Two machines are tested on five days.
The numbers of items produced are:
Machine X: $44$, $46$, $47$, $48$, $65$
Machine Y: $45$, $48$, $49$, $50$, $53$
Which machine has the higher mean, and which machine has the higher median?
mastery.solution_text:
$44, 46, 47, 48, 65$
$\overline{x}_{X} = \frac{250}{5}$
$= 50$
$\text{Median}_{X} = 47$
$45, 48, 49, 50, 53$
$\overline{x}_{Y} = \frac{245}{5}$
$= 49$
$\text{Median}_{Y} = 49$
Machine X has the higher mean, $50$ compared with $49$.
Machine Y has the higher median, $49$ compared with $47$.
